item.title: Dangerous corner, 17th August
item.description:
As cars come up Clarence street they can go straight on to town or loop round to the right onto St. George’s place both without stopping. I have witnessed and experienced cars taking that corner to the right into St. George’s without slowing and there are often people crossing the road across St. George’s place next to the church who have almost been run over. Pedestrians are assuming that cars are turning at a junction not a continuous road as it’s not clear at all. Three days ago too someone turning right out of St. George’s place almost knocked over someone with a bike and a small child on the back as all are assuming the road only goes continuously straight and there were continuing to the right. There is going to be a serious accident there hence my note. The road design is horrendous and amazed that it was designed that way as no signs warning people. Why isn’t the junction between St. George’s place and Clarence a junction it would be so much safer. Please do something before someone gets hurt.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 42, Clarence Street, Marle Hill, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Grass issue, 17th August
item.description:
This area in near the Co-op on Greet road, post code GL54 5PU. Not only is this area looking untidy but it posses a real fire hazard with the potential to damage properties if alight. With the Government warning issued regards the extreme heat conditions it would be sensible to get this cut as its at higher risk due to being by a public location (shop) and more likely for someone to discard without thinking, Also due to the extreme weather i would think the normal grass cutting schedule would not be needed as the grass would not have grown. The area of grass at this location has not been cut since last year which wasn't till end of the year again.
